description.en: The name of the application to which the stream belongs.

description.zh: 结束时间。结束时间需晚于起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。
description.en: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

description.zh: 当前页码。默认值为1。取值范围为：1~100000。
description.en: The page number. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100000.

description.zh: 每页大小。默认20，最大500，取值：1~500之前的任意整数。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 20. Maximum value: 500. Valid values: any integer from 1 to 500.

description.zh:
起始时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。

> 支持查询最近7天内的数据。
description.en:
The start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC).

> You can query data within the last 7 days.

description.zh:
回调是否成功。
- success：成功。
- failed：失败。
description.en:
Specifies whether the callback was successful. Valid values:
- success: The callback was successful.
- failed: The callback failed.

description.zh:
查询对应录制储存方式的回调记录。

- oss: 录制到oss

- vod: 录制到vod

- all: 不区分存储类型，查询所有存储方式的回调记录
description.en:
The storage type of the recording for which you want to query callback records. Valid values:

- oss: recordings stored in OSS.

- vod: recordings stored in ApsaraVideo VOD.

- all: callback records for all storage types without distinction.

title.zh: 查询直播录制回调记录
title.en: Query live stream recording callback records

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为100次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en: The China site (Chinese) single-user QPS limit for this API is 100 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Manage your calls appropriately.
